name: io.github.futuur/futuur-mcp
title: Futuur
description: Futuur prediction markets: browse events and prices, simulate and place orders, track positions.

environmentVariables.name: FUTUUR_PUBLIC_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Futuur API public key. Optional for browsing markets; needed for account and trading tools. Create a key pair at futuur.com → Settings → API keys.

environmentVariables.name: FUTUUR_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Futuur API private key. Optional for browsing markets; needed for account and trading tools. Create a key pair at futuur.com → Settings → API keys.
